papers.title: GEAR-VLA: Learning Geometry-Aware Action Representations for Generalizable Robotic Manipulation
papers.summary: 现有 VLA 在真实部署面对新物体、背景变化和不同机器人本体时泛化能力差。作者认为根因是缺乏统一的几何感知动作表示，于是提出 GEAR-VLA，用粗到细的动作学习、3D 空间分支对齐以及本体规范化把动作语义和几何统一起来。在 LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus、RoboTwin 2.0 上达到 SOTA，AgileX 真机 85.9%、未见本体 LDT-01 81.0%，6360 次抓取测试达 90.1%。
papers.original_abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models achieve strong benchmark performance but still struggle in real-world deployment with unseen objects, background shifts, and different robot embodiments. We argue that this stems from the lack of a unified geometry-aware manipulation representation, leaving existing VLAs vulnerable to low-level trajectory supervision, misaligned 3D features, and embodiment differences. To address this, we propose GEAR-VLA, a VLA framework for learning unified geometry-aware action representations for generalizable robotic manipulation. GEAR-VLA adopts coarse-to-fine action learning, where multi-source embodied pretraining equips the VLM with embodied reasoning and discrete action understanding before latent action tokens connect action semantics to a gradient-decoupled DiT continuous action expert. It further performs semantic-aligned 3D integration by aligning a trainable 3D spatial backbone with the VLA representation while freezing the original VLM-aligned visual pathway. To share this representation across robots, GEAR-VLA uses embodiment canonicalization, where embodiment-aware states and embodiment-invariant actions confine robot differences to the low-level interface. Extensive simulation and real-world experiments demonstrate strong generalization: GEAR-VLA achieves state-of-the-art performance on LIBERO, zero-shot LIBERO-Plus, and RoboTwin 2.0, reaches 85.9% success on AgileX and 81.0% on the pretraining-unseen LDT-01 embodiment, and obtains 90.1% success on a 6,360-trial universal grasping benchmark with 212 unseen objects. Code and models will be released at https://github.com/babynabeauty/GEAR-VLA.

highlights.contribution: 提出一个统一的几何感知 VLA 框架 GEAR-VLA，把 3D 几何先验和本体规范化引入动作表示，显著提升跨物体跨本体泛化。
highlights.innovation: 区别于纯 2D 视觉或后接 3D 编码的做法，GEAR-VLA 把 VLM 视觉通路冻结、单独训练 3D 空间分支并与之对齐，并通过本体规范化把机器人差异限制在底层接口。
highlights.method: 先做多源具身预训练得到带动作理解的 VLM，再用 latent action token 桥接到去耦梯度的 DiT 连续动作专家；同时对齐一条可训练 3D 空间通路；状态做本体感知、动作做本体不变。
highlights.results: LIBERO/LIBERO-Plus/RoboTwin 2.0 拿到 SOTA；AgileX 真机 85.9%，未见本体 LDT-01 81.0%；6360 次、212 类未见物体的抓取 benchmark 上 90.1%。

papers.title: FiberTune: Preserving Action-Fiber Visual Residuals in Vision-Language-Action Fine-Tuning
papers.summary: 作者发现 VLA 微调时只约束影响动作的方向，视觉结构沿动作等价方向会塌缩。提出 FiberTune：在线学一个动作探针估出预测动作的视觉方向，把它从中间视觉 token 中过滤掉，再把残差对齐到冻结的视觉教师并约束有效秩。在六个仿真设置和真机 SO-101 上一致提升，CALVIN ABC→D 长程 SR(5) 提了 10.7 个点。
papers.original_abstract: Action-supervised fine-tuning of vision-language-action (VLA) policies fits demonstrations effectively but constrains only the directions that change predicted actions, leaving visual structure consistent across action-equivalent states free to collapse. We formalize this as residual visual collapse along local action fibers and propose FiberTune, a training-time objective that preserves teacher-structured visual residuals without adding inference-time overhead. FiberTune uses an online action probe to estimate action-predictive feature directions, filters them from intermediate visual-token representations, and aligns the resulting probe-filtered residuals to a frozen visual teacher while regularizing their effective rank. Under identical training conditions, FiberTune improves over task-loss-only fine-tuning in every one of six controlled simulation settings spanning two benchmarks and two architectures (pi_0.5 and OpenVLA-OFT), as well as on physical SO-101 pick-place; representative gains include +10.7 percentage points SR(5) on long-horizon CALVIN ABC-to-D and physical SO-101 task success rising from 72.7% to 78.1%. Residual diagnostics show that these gains coincide with increased probe-filtered residual teacher alignment and effective rank, consistent with the action-fiber motivation.

highlights.contribution: 形式化了 VLA 微调中的「动作纤维残差视觉塌缩」并给出训练期解决方案 FiberTune，不增加推理开销。
highlights.innovation: 不是简单蒸馏视觉特征，而是先用动作探针过滤掉动作相关方向，再让正交残差对齐教师，并显式约束残差有效秩。
highlights.method: 在中间视觉特征上挂一个在线动作探针，估出动作预测方向；从特征里减去这些方向得到残差；残差和冻结视觉教师对齐，同时加有效秩正则；与原任务损失同时优化。
highlights.results: 在 pi_0.5、OpenVLA-OFT 两架构 × 两个 benchmark 共 6 个设置都赢；CALVIN ABC→D SR(5) +10.7pp；真机 SO-101 pick-place 由 72.7% 提到 78.1%。

papers.title: BLUE: Toward Better Language Use in Efficient Vision-Language-Action Models for Autonomous Driving
papers.summary: 自动驾驶 VLA 每帧都生成语言其实是浪费，因为只在少量路段语言才真正起作用。作者训了一个 0.11M 的轻量 gate 在冻结的 VLA 隐状态上判断「这帧要不要走语言路径」。在 Bench2Drive 上拿到 76.2% 成功率、Longest6 v2 36 driving score 的 SOTA，推理加速 2.54 倍。
papers.original_abstract: We present BLUE, a minimal method for better language use in vision-language-action (VLA) models for autonomous driving (AD). Through extensive analysis, we reveal that language matters on only a small fraction of routes, but on those routes it can greatly improve or degrade performance. Generating language at every frame is therefore inefficient, since most computation is spent on frames that do not benefit from language. We further show that pretrained VLA hidden states potentially already encode whether language will benefit a given frame, even though scene complexity and kinematic features alone struggle to predict this. Based on this finding, BLUE trains a lightweight gate on frozen VLA hidden states to decide per frame whether to activate language generation or predict actions directly, without modifying the backbone or requiring additional human annotation. With just a 0.11M-parameter gate, BLUE sets a new state of the art on both benchmarks, achieving 76.2% success rate on Bench2Drive and 36 driving score on Longest6 v2, while delivering 2.54x inference speedup and 8.9% success rate improvement over the backbone. BLUE provides a practical path toward efficient language-augmented AD, showing that VLA models can retain the benefits of language at a fraction of the cost. Our code, data, logs and checkpoints are fully available on https://github.com/George-Ling3/BLUE.

highlights.contribution: 提出 BLUE，用极轻量 gate 决定 VLA 何时启用语言生成，在自动驾驶上做到「保留语言收益、砍掉无用算力」。
highlights.innovation: 首次定量揭示语言在驾驶 VLA 中只对少量帧有用，并证明冻结 VLA 隐状态已经隐式编码了「这帧需不需要语言」。
highlights.method: 冻住 VLA 主干，加 0.11M 参数 gate 接在 VLA 隐状态上，输出 per-frame 决策：要语言就走 token 生成路径，否则直接预测动作；不需要额外人标。
highlights.results: Bench2Drive 76.2% SR、Longest6 v2 36 DS 同时拿 SOTA；推理 2.54× 加速，成功率比 backbone +8.9pp。

papers.title: PACT: Self-Evolving Physical Safety Alignment for Diffusion Policies in Embodied Manipulation
papers.summary: Diffusion policy 表现强但常常违反物理安全约束。作者提出 PACT：后训练阶段直接把约束梯度蒸馏进 diffusion 策略，用 reverse-KL 在所有时间步上做密集监督，再用 curriculum 慢慢收紧约束。不用 demo 不用 reward，安全违规平均减少 31%，任务成功率反而 +30.7%。
papers.original_abstract: Diffusion policies have achieved remarkable success in robotic manipulation, yet they often fail to satisfy strict physical constraints required for safe deployment. Existing approaches impose safety either prematurely during training or reactively via external guardrails at test time, limiting policy expressivity and overall scalability. We propose Physical safety Alignment for Constrained Trajectories (PACT), a self-evolving post-training framework that projects pretrained diffusion policies onto constraint-feasible regions without accessing demonstration data or task rewards. PACT distills constraint gradients into the diffusion model through a reverse-KL objective with dense supervision across timesteps. It incorporates a curriculum that progressively tightens constraints while maintaining theoretically bounded policy shift and monotone improvement, mitigating the safety-performance trade-off from catastrophic forgetting. On simulated and real-world embodied manipulation benchmarks, PACT significantly reduces safety violations by 31.0% on average while improving task success by 30.7%.

highlights.contribution: 提出自演化的 diffusion policy 安全对齐框架 PACT，无需 demo 或 reward 就能把策略投影到约束可行域。
highlights.innovation: 不像现有方法在训练期硬塞约束或推理期外挂 guardrail，PACT 在后训练阶段用 reverse-KL + curriculum 做温和对齐，理论上保证策略偏移有界且单调改进。
highlights.method: 拿预训练 diffusion 策略，对每个去噪步施加约束梯度，用 reverse-KL 把策略推向约束可行；课程逐步收紧约束防灾难性遗忘；不读 demo 不读 reward。
highlights.results: 在仿真和真机 manipulation 上安全违规平均 −31%，任务成功率 +30.7%。

papers.title: GraspFoM: Towards Reconstruction-Driven Robotic Grasping with 3D Foundation Priors
papers.summary: 现有几何感知抓取把重建当中间产物而不是可复用的物体先验。作者基于 SAM3D 搭了 GraspFoM：共享一个 3D 物体 latent 同时做重建和抓取姿态预测，再加锚点初始化的截断 pose 扩散器。重建和抓取互相受益，参数加得不多，两个任务都拿 SOTA。
papers.original_abstract: Robotic grasping is a fundamental capability in robotic manipulation. Yet grasping remains challenging under partial observations. Reliable grasping depends on both local contact cues and object-level 3D structure. Existing geometry-aware grasping methods recognize the value of reconstruction, but they typically treat geometry as an intermediate prediction rather than a reusable object prior for grasping. In this paper, we present GraspFoM, a unified framework that leverages 3D foundation priors (SAM3D) to build a shared 3D object latent for both reconstruction and grasp pose prediction. Built on this shared object latent, we introduce an anchor-initialized truncated pose-reasoning diffuser that predicts continuous and multimodal grasp poses without directly relying on discrete grasp candidates. We further investigate the interaction between reconstruction and grasping through a reconstruction-aware scorer and a residual latent updater. Reconstruction provides grounded geometric cues, while grasp supervision refines the shared object latent toward grasp-relevant affordances. GraspFoM jointly predicts grasp poses and reconstructs high-fidelity 3D assets in mesh and 3DGS forms. Comprehensive experiments demonstrate that GraspFoM achieves state-of-the-art results on both reconstruction and grasping. Notably, these improvements require only a small number of additional trainable parameters. Component-wise ablation studies also demonstrate the contribution of each component.

highlights.contribution: 提出统一的 3D 基础模型驱动框架 GraspFoM，把高保真重建和抓取姿态预测耦合在一个共享 latent 上。
highlights.innovation: 用 SAM3D 作为 3D foundation prior 提取共享物体 latent，并设计 reconstruction-aware scorer + residual latent updater 让两个任务互相喂梯度。
highlights.method: 输入部分观测，用 SAM3D 编码出 3D 物体 latent；一头解码出 mesh/3DGS 重建，一头通过锚点初始化的截断扩散器预测多模态抓取姿态；scorer 和 updater 让两任务联合优化。
highlights.results: 重建和抓取两边都拿 SOTA；额外可训练参数很少（具体数字未给）。

papers.title: EgoPriMo: Egocentric Motion Generation for Interactive Humanoid Control
papers.summary: 人形机器人需要适应场景、任务和用户意图的全身动作，但 motion tracking 和 VLA 都不算可交互的全身行为先验。作者用第一视角人类示范学了一个 EgoPriMo：基于 SMPL，文字作为高层控制信号，单 checkpoint 同时做重建、生成、预测。在 Nymeria 和 EgoExo4D 上超过 UniEgoMotion，生成的动作可被宇树人形执行。
papers.original_abstract: Humanoid robots require whole-body motions that adapt to scene context, task requirements, and user intent. Motion tracking reproduces specified trajectories, and humanoid vision-language-action systems provide semantic interfaces, but neither offers a scalable and interactive prior for broad full-body behavior. We introduce EgoPriMo (Egocentric Motion Prior for Humanoid Robots), a unified framework that learns such priors from egocentric human demonstrations. Given egocentric observations and a text prompt, EgoPriMo reconstructs, generates, and forecasts SMPL-based full-body motion. Language is used as a high-level control signal rather than a complete motion specification. At the core of EgoPriMo is a Triple-stream DiT that jointly models body dynamics, egocentric visual context, and text; task-conditioning masks route different tasks and missing-modality data through the same checkpoint. Experiments on Nymeria and EgoExo4D show that one checkpoint improves egocentric motion generation over UniEgoMotion while supporting reconstruction and forecasting; the generated SMPL motions can also be executed by a Unitree humanoid controller. These results indicate a practical path from scalable egocentric observations to generalizable and interactive humanoid motion priors.

highlights.contribution: 提出 EgoPriMo，从第一视角人类示范学到可交互的人形全身动作先验，单 checkpoint 同时做重建、生成、预测。
highlights.innovation: 三流 DiT 同时建模身体动力学、第一视角视觉和文本，并用 task-conditioning mask 在同一模型里路由不同任务和缺失模态。
highlights.method: 输入第一视角观测和文字 prompt，输出 SMPL 全身动作；Triple-stream DiT 三路融合，任务/缺失模态由 mask 控制；生成结果可丢给 Unitree 控制器执行。
highlights.results: Nymeria、EgoExo4D 上 ego-motion 生成超过 UniEgoMotion；同 checkpoint 兼顾重建/预测；动作可在真人形机器人执行。

papers.title: Benchmarking Vision-Language-Action Models on SO-101: Failure and Recovery Analysis
papers.summary: 现有 VLA 评测大多在仿真或昂贵机器人上做，低成本平台的真实表现没人系统看过。作者在低成本 SO-101 上搭了一个标准 benchmark，跑 π0.5、SmolVLA、Wall-X、ACT 四个策略，引入失败分类和恢复指标。结论是预训练 VLA 一般优于 IL，但执行不稳定是主要失败源，恢复能力差异巨大。
papers.original_abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have demonstrated strong generalization in robotic manipulation, yet existing evaluations are primarily conducted in simulation or on expensive robotic platforms, leaving their robustness on affordable real-world robots largely unexplored. We present a standardized real-world benchmark for evaluating representative VLA and imitation learning policies on the low-cost SO-101 robotic platform. The benchmark comprises four representative manipulation tasks together with unified evaluation protocols, enabling systematic comparison under embodiment uncertainty. Using real-world teleoperated demonstrations, we fine-tune and evaluate $π_{0.5}$, SmolVLA, Wall-X, and ACT directly on the physical platform. Beyond conventional task success rates, the benchmark incorporates a structured failure taxonomy, semantic- and execution-level failure decomposition, and recovery-aware evaluation metrics to characterize policy robustness. Experimental results show that stronger pretrained VLA policies generally outperform the imitation learning baseline, although performance remains highly task-dependent under low-cost robotic deployment conditions. Execution instability emerges as the dominant failure source, while recovery capability varies substantially across architectures. These results highlight the importance of failure and recovery analysis beyond binary task success and establish SO-101 as a practical benchmark for evaluating embodied AI systems under realistic low-cost robotic deployment conditions.

highlights.contribution: 建立了首个面向低成本机器人（SO-101）的 VLA/IL 真机 benchmark，并配上失败-恢复结构化分析协议。
highlights.innovation: 评测指标超越二元成功率，引入语义/执行层失败分解和 recovery-aware metric，把硬件不确定性变成一等问题。
highlights.method: 用真人遥操作数据在 SO-101 上微调四种代表性策略，跑 4 个任务的统一协议；除了成功率，还分类失败、量化恢复行为。
highlights.results: 预训练 VLA 普遍强于 ACT，但任务依赖强；执行不稳定是主要失败源，不同架构的恢复能力差异很大（无统一 SOTA 数字）。

papers.title: Real-IKEA: Physical Fidelity is the Prerequisite for Robust Manipulation
papers.summary: 作者认为 sim 训出来的策略不 robust 是因为物理保真度不够，于是做了 Real-IKEA：1079 个铰接资产配置，源自 83 个真实 IKEA 把手和旋钮，经过六步物理工作流处理。用 RL 训出来的策略学到了 hooking、levering 这种依赖机械优势的鲁棒策略，而不是脆弱的摩擦拉拽。
papers.original_abstract: Robotic manipulation robustness often founders on the physics gap between simplified simulations and the resistance-laden real world. In this work, we emphasize that physical realism in articulated interaction is an important ingredient for robust policy learning. We present Real-IKEA, a dataset and simulation framework designed with physical accuracy as a first-class goal. Real-IKEA provides 1,079 articulated asset configurations, derived from 83 authentic IKEA handles and knobs processed through a meticulous six-step physical workflow. For contact-geometry accuracy, we introduce a bidirectional surface-deviation metric to quantify collision meshes. For dynamics realism, we establish resistance-calibrated configurations that vary damping and friction. Crucially, we demonstrate through a Reinforcement Learning (RL) policy that high-fidelity assets enable the discovery of robust "hooking" and "levering" strategies that prioritize mechanical advantage over fragile friction-pulling. Together, these results position Real-IKEA as a critical benchmark for developing manipulation policies capable of human-level robustness in articulated object tasks.

highlights.contribution: 提出 Real-IKEA 数据集和仿真框架，把物理保真度作为一等公民，专为铰接物体操作打造。
highlights.innovation: 引入双向表面偏差度量衡量碰撞 mesh 准确度，并提供阻尼/摩擦校准的多套动力学配置，让 sim 真的「像真的」。
highlights.method: 对 83 个真实 IKEA 把手/旋钮跑六步物理工作流（建模、表面校准、动力学校准等），得到 1079 个铰接配置；在 Isaac/Sim 类环境里用 RL 训操作策略。
highlights.results: RL 策略学到机械优势主导的 hooking 和 levering 策略，在铰接物体任务上表现远稳于摩擦依赖策略（具体提升数字未列）。

papers.title: Dream-Tac: A Unified Tactile World Action Model for Contact-Rich Robot Manipulation
papers.summary: World action model 主要靠视觉，碰到接触丰富的任务时手感缺失就翻车。作者提出 Dream-Tac：联合建模动作、未来视觉观察和触觉动态，用 contact-gated 视触觉融合和 contact-aware attention bias 调控跨模态。还设计了双层加速：训练 2.9× 快、推理 1.8× 快，6 个接触密集任务动作精度平均提 31.7%。
papers.original_abstract: World action models inherit the predictive capability of world models, enabling action generation to be guided by anticipated future observations. However, they rely primarily on vision and often fail in contact-rich manipulation, where critical cues arise from physical interaction. In this paper, we propose Dream-Tac, a unified Tactile-World Action Model that jointly models actions, future visual observations, and tactile dynamics. Specifically, Dream-Tac introduces (i) contact-gated visuotactile fusion to selectively integrate tactile signals and (ii) a contact-aware attention bias to better regulate cross-modal interactions during manipulation. To support real-time deployment, we further design a dual-level acceleration strategy, reformulating the contact-aware bias to preserve the fused attention path during training and introducing cache-based diffusion acceleration at inference, achieving up to 2.9$\times$ faster training and 1.8$\times$ faster inference. Across six contact-rich manipulation tasks, Dream-Tac improves action accuracy by 31.7\% on average, demonstrating the effectiveness of unified visuotactile world modeling.Code is available at https://github.com/LYFCLOUDFAN/Dream-Tac.

highlights.contribution: 提出统一的 Tactile-World Action Model Dream-Tac，把视觉、触觉、动作和未来观测一起建模，专攻接触密集操作。
highlights.innovation: 用 contact-gated visuotactile fusion 选择性引入触觉，并把 contact-aware bias 重构进 attention 路径，使其在训练加速时仍可保留融合通路。
highlights.method: 输入历史视觉+力/触觉，预测未来动作、未来视觉以及触觉动态；融合用门控开关，attention 加 contact-aware bias；推理用 cache-based diffusion 加速。
highlights.results: 6 个接触密集任务上动作精度平均 +31.7%，训练加速 2.9×，推理加速 1.8×。

papers.title: Unifying Object-Centric World Models and Diffusion Policy: A Hierarchical Framework for Multi-Stage Robotic Tasks
papers.summary: 视觉 world model 在单阶段抓取/到达任务可以做 MPC，但多阶段长程任务搞不动。LeCun 组提出 WorldDP：高层用以物体为中心的 world model 优化可行子目标，底层用 Diffusion Policy 执行。物体级表征解耦实体，能按物体顺序规划，在多个机器人 benchmark 上一致超基线。
papers.original_abstract: Visual world models have shown great potential in learning complex system dynamics. Recent advancements leverage these models as transition functions within Model Predictive Control (MPC) frameworks to solve various control tasks. When applied to robotics, however, they are limited to single-stage tasks such as reaching or grasping, and struggle with multi-stage ones that demand complex sequential planning. In this work, we introduce WorldDP, a world model framework designed for multi-stage robotic manipulation. Our hierarchical approach utilizes a high-level world model as a transition function to optimize for feasible subgoals during runtime, which are subsequently reached by a low-level Diffusion Policy. To further aid in learning dynamics and planning, we incorporate object-centric representations that decouple environmental entities and enable us to plan sequentially with respect to each. Evaluated across several robotics benchmarks, WorldDP consistently outperforms existing baselines, validating that coupling the world model's physically grounded planning with diffusion policy's efficient execution yields superior multi-stage performance.

highlights.contribution: 提出层级化的 WorldDP，把 object-centric world model 和 Diffusion Policy 合体来处理多阶段操作。
highlights.innovation: 用物体级表征解耦场景实体，让 world model 能按物体逐个规划子目标，再由底层 diffusion policy 物理执行，弥补单一 world model 在长程任务的不足。
highlights.method: 高层 object-centric world model 在 MPC 里搜可行 subgoal；底层 Diffusion Policy 接收 subgoal 直接生成动作；两层都用物体槽位表征。
highlights.results: 多个机器人 benchmark 上一致超越基线（具体数字未列），多阶段任务收益最明显。

papers.title: FAWAM: Force-Aware World Action Models for Closed-Loop Contact-Rich Manipulation
papers.summary: 力/触觉常被当作额外观测，没真正喂进动力学预测和闭环纠错。FAWAM 把力信号分三层用：编码历史 6 轴力矩调制动作生成、联合预测未来动作和末端力矩、最后用预测力矩作参考做在线残差纠错。多个接触密集任务上比 vision-only 高 36.25%，比已有力感方法高 21.25%。
papers.original_abstract: Force signals provide critical interaction cues for contact-rich robotic manipulation. However, existing methods mostly use force as an additional observation modality, without fully exploiting its role in modeling future interaction dynamics or guiding execution-time feedback correction. In this paper, we propose FAWAM, a force-aware world action model that incorporates force information at three levels: perception, prediction, and closed-loop execution. FAWAM first encodes historical 6-axis force/torque signals to modulate action generation, then jointly predicts future actions and end-effector wrenches to explicitly model contact evolution. It further introduces a residual correction module that uses the predicted wrench trajectory as an execution-time reference to refine actions online based on real-time force feedback. Real-world experiments across multiple contact-rich tasks show that FAWAM improves the average success rate by 36.25% over vision-only baselines and 21.25% over existing force-aware baselines, demonstrating the effectiveness of our force-aware framework for robust contact-rich manipulation.

highlights.contribution: 提出 FAWAM，第一次把力信号同时用在感知、未来预测、闭环执行三个层级，做接触密集操作的力感 WAM。
highlights.innovation: 提出 wrench-aware future prediction + residual correction，用预测的力矩轨迹作为执行期参考来在线修正动作，而不是只把力当输入。
highlights.method: 编码历史 6 轴力/力矩调制动作生成；模型联合预测未来动作和未来 end-effector wrench；执行时用预测 wrench 与实测力比较，残差模块在线修动作。
highlights.results: 真机多个接触密集任务平均成功率比 vision-only +36.25pp、比已有力感方法 +21.25pp。

papers.title: HARBOR: A Harness Framework for Agentic Robot Reinforcement Learning
papers.summary: 机器人 RL 慢的不是算法是工程链：任务、奖励、超参全要专家调。HARBOR 把这套流程定义成「线束工程」问题，由专门 agent 通过标准命令、可执行 gate、可复用知识把环境搭建到策略训练全自动化。在 6 个 benchmark、16 个任务上端到端跑通，策略可迁到真机。
papers.original_abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) has become a powerful paradigm for robot learning, particularly in sim-to-real settings, but its broader adoption remains limited by the engineering pipeline surrounding the algorithms. Building tasks, shaping rewards, and tuning hyperparameters require substantial expert effort, making RL workflows costly and difficult to scale. We introduce HARBOR, an agentic framework that frames robot RL automation as a harness-engineering problem: given a simulator codebase and a task specification, it automates the workflow from environment setup to policy training in simulation. HARBOR decomposes such high-level objectives into bounded stages executed by specialized agents through standardized commands, persistent artifacts, executable gates, and reusable knowledge, and scales iteration via decentralized parallel trials and experience learning across runs. We evaluate HARBOR across 6 benchmarks and 16 tasks in total, spanning manipulation, locomotion, and bimanual dexterous control. We demonstrate that HARBOR automates the simulation RL workflow end-to-end, designs rewards, tunes algorithms to match or improve over default configurations, and reduces engineering effort at practical token and wall-clock cost; the resulting policies can also be transferred to real robots.

highlights.contribution: 提出 HARBOR，把机器人 RL 工程链 (env 搭建、奖励设计、超参调优) 当作 harness 自动化问题用 agentic 框架解决。
highlights.innovation: 把高层目标分解成有限阶段，由专门 agent 通过标准命令、持久工件和可执行 gate 推进，并支持去中心化并行试验与经验复用。
highlights.method: 输入 simulator codebase + 任务规范；agents 按阶段依次设置环境、设计奖励、调超参、训策略；多 trial 并行；策略最终可迁真机。
highlights.results: 6 个 benchmark、16 个任务（操作/移动/双手灵巧）端到端跑通，奖励和算法配置自动得出且匹配或优于默认设置；token 和 wall-clock 成本可控。

papers.title: Scaffold Effects on GAIA: A Controlled Comparison
papers.summary: 你看到的 agent 排行榜其实是 scaffold + 模型的混合分。作者预注册做了一组对照实验：3 种 scaffold × 5 个模型（Claude 4.7/4.6/4.5、Gemini 3.1 Pro、GPT-5.5）在 GAIA Level 1/2 上各 3 次。结论：scaffold 单独就能把同一模型的准确率拉开 28pp；更强的模型未必更不依赖 scaffold，多智能体优势只在 Anthropic 家族出现。
papers.original_abstract: Published agent capability scores conflate what a model can do with what its scaffold lets it do, and the magnitude of this elicitation gap is not well characterized under controlled conditions. This study executes a pre-registered controlled comparison of three scaffolds (ReAct, a Planner-Actor-Rater multi-agent design, and planner-then-executor) across five models from three providers (Claude Opus 4.7, Sonnet 4.6, Haiku 4.5; Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview; GPT-5.5) on GAIA validation Levels 1 and 2, holding tasks and conditions fixed, with three attempts per question. Scaffold choice alone moves measured accuracy by as much as 28 percentage points within a single model (Opus, Level 2, robust slice), confirming the pre-registered hypothesis that scaffold variation produces gaps of at least 10 points. The pre-registered prediction that more capable models would be less scaffold-sensitive is rejected in direction: scaffold effects vary significantly by model in every dataset slice, but the most capable Anthropic model gains the most from structured scaffolds at the harder level, and tier-scaling holds only at Level 1 under the robust slice. The multi-agent advantage over ReAct at Level 2 appears within the Anthropic family but not for the cross-provider models, making model family rather than capability tier the conditioning variable, and the predicted planner-executor advantage on file-reading tasks is falsified. Structured scaffolds make fewer tool calls yet recover more often from mid-trajectory errors at the harder level, and a single cell (Gemini with planner-then-executor) is the cheapest at both levels and the most accurate at Level 2. These results indicate that single-scaffold capability numbers are scaffold-conditional estimates and that the elicitation gap is not guaranteed to shrink as models improve.

highlights.contribution: 首次在预注册严控条件下系统量化 agent scaffold 的 elicitation gap，证明单 scaffold 的能力分都是 scaffold 条件估计。
highlights.innovation: 预注册假设对照 + 跨厂商 5 模型 × 3 scaffold × 2 难度 × 3 attempt，引入「scaffold 效应是否随能力缩小」可证伪检验。
highlights.method: GAIA validation L1/L2 固定任务集；ReAct、Planner-Actor-Rater、Planner-then-Executor 三 scaffold；五模型每题 3 次；统计 scaffold × model × level 交互。
highlights.results: Opus 在 L2 robust slice 上 scaffold 单独移动准确率 28pp；多智能体优势仅在 Anthropic 家族存在；planner-executor 在 file-reading 上未现优势；Gemini + planner-then-executor 在 L2 既最便宜又最准。

papers.title: From Player to Master: Enhancing Test-Time Learning of LLM Agents via Reinforcement Learning over Memory
papers.summary: LLM agent 在长任务里靠 memory 改进，但更新规则多半手写。MemoPilot 把 memory 更新当成多轮决策问题，用 multi-turn GRPO 端到端训：每轮一个奖励 + 上下文无关的轮级 advantage 估计，让 credit assignment 更细。在 RPS 和德州扑克上把冻结的 LLM 玩家拉到 Elo 第一（LHE 1762、RPS 1590），超过 DeepSeek-V3.2。
papers.original_abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly deployed in long-running settings where improving through experience at test time becomes important. A common approach is to update an explicit memory after each interaction to guide future decisions. However, most existing methods rely on hand-designed prompting rules, making it difficult to align memory updates with downstream objectives over multi-step horizons consistently. We propose MemoPilot, a plug-in memory copilot that explicitly trains the memory update process to improve a frozen LLM's performance across sequential interactions. We formulate memory updating as a multi-turn decision problem and optimize it end-to-end with multi-turn GRPO. Our training recipe introduces (i) a turn-wise reward signal and (ii) a context-independent, turn-level advantage estimation across rollouts, enabling finer-grained credit assignment and more stable training in multi-turn settings. We evaluate MemoPilot on two testbeds: multi-round Rock-Paper-Scissors (RPS) and Limit Texas Hold'em (LHE). Across both environments, MemoPilot substantially improves test-time learning of a frozen player over strong baselines, ranking first in Elo ratings on both games (1762 on LHE and 1590 on RPS) and outperforming all baseline memory methods and proprietary models, including DeepSeek-V3.2.

highlights.contribution: 提出 MemoPilot，把 memory 更新作为可训对象，用多轮 RL 让冻结 LLM 在长任务中持续改进。
highlights.innovation: 把 memory update 公式化成 multi-turn decision，用 turn-wise reward + context-independent turn-level advantage 做更稳的多轮 credit assignment。
highlights.method: 冻结主 LLM，挂一个 memory copilot 控制 memory 更新；用 multi-turn GRPO 训练；每轮单独给奖励，再做轮级 advantage 估计。
highlights.results: RPS Elo 1590、LHE Elo 1762，都排第一，超过所有 memory baseline 与 DeepSeek-V3.2。

papers.title: Distilling LLM Reasoning into an Interpretable Policy Tree for Human-AI Collaboration
papers.summary: 人机协作里 MARL 黑盒不安全、查 LLM 又慢又贵。Co-pi-tree 把 LLM 推理蒸馏成一棵可执行的策略树（搭档行为预测树 + 自身动作选择树），交互后用自然语言反馈修剪问题分支。Overcooked-AI 上平均奖励比基线高 35.4%，LLM 查询少 77.7%，推理延迟少 97.1%。
papers.original_abstract: Constructing efficient and reliable policies to assist humans is indispensable for human-AI collaboration. Existing methods mainly follow two lines of work. Most prior work relies on multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) to learn black-box policies, which limits interpretability and raises safety concerns. Recent methods query large language models (LLMs) at each decision step, causing slow responses and high inference costs. We propose Collaboration Policy Tree (Co-pi-tree), a closed-loop method that learns an executable policy tree consisting of a partner-behavior prediction tree and an agent-action selection tree. Co-pi-tree constructs a policy by distilling LLM reasoning into policy tree code. It then evaluates the policy through partner interaction, obtains feedback, and uses natural language to summarize the interaction feedback to improve problematic branches. Experiments in Overcooked-AI show that Co-pi-tree improves average reward by 35.4% over the baseline average, while reducing the number of LLM queries by 77.7% and test-time latency by 97.1%. Project page: https://beiwenzhang.github.io/Co-pi-tree/

highlights.contribution: 提出 Co-pi-tree，把 LLM 推理蒸馏成可解释、可执行、可在线改的策略树，用于人机协作。
highlights.innovation: 区别于每步查 LLM 或纯 MARL 黑盒，Co-pi-tree 离线蒸馏后只在闭环反馈中用自然语言修剪问题分支，兼顾解释性和效率。
highlights.method: 两棵树：搭档行为预测树 + 自身动作选择树；初始结构由 LLM 推理蒸馏成代码；与搭档交互拿反馈，再用自然语言总结去改问题分支。
highlights.results: Overcooked-AI 平均奖励 +35.4%，LLM 查询数减少 77.7%，测试时延迟减少 97.1%。

papers.title: PhysAgent: Automating Physics-Based 4D Synthesis via Trajectory-Grounded Multi-Agent Feedback
papers.summary: 4D 物理动作合成里材质优化已有不少工作，但外力场全靠人手配。PhysAgent 是一个 simulator-in-the-loop 多智能体框架：语义 Agent 配带力场技能模块给出初始化，Refine Agents 用 vision foundation model 从渲染帧抽取点轨迹再翻成文字反馈，靠 LLM 常识跳出局部最优、动态切换离散力场。
papers.original_abstract: Achieving fully automated, physically plausible 3D motion synthesis is a core objective in graphics and generative AI. However, configuring complex environmental force fields still relies entirely on manual expert intervention, creating a severe bottleneck for large-scale simulation data generation. Existing automated methods primarily focus on material optimization and exhibit severe modality gaps and technical flaws when applied to the vastly more complex force field optimization space: naive Large Language Models (LLMs) lack underlying simulation feedback, causing severe physical inaccuracies, while traditional Score Distillation Sampling (SDS) suffers from sluggish gradients, local optima entrapment, and a mathematical inability to dynamically switch discrete force fields. To address this, we propose PhysAgent, the first simulator-in-the-loop multi-agent framework that leverages multimodal inputs for automated, physically grounded 4D synthesis. By decoupling intrinsic materials from extrinsic dynamics, PhysAgent utilizes a Semantic Agent equipped with an externalized Force Field Skill module to master simulation rules and generate valid initializations. Subsequently, the Refine Agents, driven by Trajectory-Grounded Multi-Agent Feedback, leverage vision foundation models to extract dense point trajectories from rendered frames. By converting these explicit motion trajectories into structured textual descriptors, the agent harnesses LLM commonsense reasoning to execute zero-shot macroscopic leaps, effectively escaping local optima and dynamically switching discrete force fields. Extensive experiments demonstrate that PhysAgent rapidly generates stable, diverse physical scenes from arbitrary multimodal prompts, significantly outperforming existing baselines in both generation diversity and physical accuracy.

highlights.contribution: 提出首个把外力场自动化的多智能体 4D 合成框架 PhysAgent，让物理仿真摆脱手配力场。
highlights.innovation: 把物质属性和外部动力学解耦，并引入 Trajectory-Grounded Multi-Agent Feedback：把渲染轨迹翻成文字让 LLM 做宏观跳跃式优化，绕开 SDS 局部最优。
highlights.method: Semantic Agent 用力场技能模块给出初始化；模拟器跑出渲染帧；Refine Agents 用视觉基础模型抽点轨迹，转成结构化文本描述，LLM 据此修正参数或切换力场类型；循环到收敛。
highlights.results: 在多模态 prompt 上生成稳定多样物理场景，生成多样性和物理准确性显著超过基线（具体数字未列）。

papers.title: SceneConductor: 3D Scene Generation from Single Image with Multi-Agent Orchestration
papers.summary: 单图生成完整 3D 场景需要全局几何一致性。SceneConductor 把任务拆三阶段：先做对象级初始化和粗布局，再构建支撑面/房间边界/材质/光照的环境支架，最后多智能体精修。还引入几何感知 layout 预测器，只用稀疏点云监督就能泛化到真实场景，几何精度、空间一致性、感知真实性都超之前方法。
papers.original_abstract: Generating complete 3D scenes from a single image requires inferring globally consistent geometry, object relationships, and environmental context from inherently ambiguous visual evidence. Despite recent progress in joint layout-and-mesh generation, existing methods often rely on holistic or weakly decomposed pipelines that entangle many factors at once and demand extensive scene-level supervision, limiting their generalization to complex real-world environments. We propose a multi-agent orchestration framework that decomposes single-image 3D scene generation into three structured stages: scene initialization, environment construction, and multi-agent refinement. The initialization stage extracts image-derived object masks, builds object-level 3D representations, and predicts an initial spatial layout to form a coarse 3D scene. The environment-construction stage then leverages this initialization together with point-map geometry to build an environmental scaffold of supporting surfaces, room boundaries, materials, and illumination. Finally, in the refinement stage, a planner agent identifies structural and visual inconsistencies, applies simple corrections directly, and dispatches specialist agents for complex localized revisions that are reintegrated into the global scene. To provide reliable structural initialization while reducing reliance on scene-level annotations, we further introduce a geometry-aware layout predictor supervised by sparse geometric priors derived from point maps. Unlike fully supervised layout generators, the predictor can be trained from segmentation-level data and generalizes robustly to diverse real-world scenes. Extensive experiments on benchmark datasets show that our method consistently outperforms prior approaches in geometric accuracy, spatial consistency, and perceptual realism.

highlights.contribution: 提出多智能体 orchestration 单图 3D 场景生成框架 SceneConductor，把布局、环境、精修分阶段处理。
highlights.innovation: 用 planner agent 找问题、自己改简单的、调用专家 agent 改复杂局部并整合回全局；layout 预测器靠点云稀疏先验监督，不靠场景级标注。
highlights.method: Stage1：分割 + 物体级 3D 表征 + 初始布局；Stage2：用 point map 构建支撑面/房间边界/材质/光照支架；Stage3：planner agent + specialist agents 多轮局部精修。
highlights.results: 在 benchmark 数据集上几何精度、空间一致性、感知真实性都一致超过 prior（无具体数字）。

papers.title: LUNA-AD: Lightweight Uncertainty-Aware Language Model with Lifelong Learning for Autonomous Driving
papers.summary: 把 LLM 塞进自驾会面临推理多样性低、算力高、学习方式静态的问题。LUNA-AD 用三系统架构：多智能体生成不确定性感知的决策示范、用 dual-head 轻量模型同时蒸馏决策分布和文字解释、再加 reflection 驱动的终身学习闭环。在 nuPlan 反应/非反应模式都达 SOTA，推理延迟显著降低。
papers.original_abstract: While large language models (LLMs) offer promising reasoning capabilities, their integration into safety-critical driving systems is hindered by limited reasoning diversity, high computational overhead, and static learning paradigms. To address these challenges, we propose LUNA-AD, a lightweight uncertainty-aware language model with lifelong learning for autonomous driving (AD). LUNA-AD features a tri-system architecture that reconciles complex multimodal behavioral reasoning, efficient deployment, and continual refinement. We design a multi-agent analytical system to generate uncertainty-aware decision-making demonstrations through diverse hypothesis exploration. A dual-head lightweight heuristic model is distilled to unify the inference of decision distributions and textual explanations while enabling efficient deployment. Furthermore, a reflection-driven lifelong learning mechanism operates on multimodal decision outputs and preserves strategic diversity, allowing for the refinement of candidate decisions and rationales via closed-loop feedback to enhance driving robustness. Extensive experiments on nuPlan benchmarks demonstrate that LUNA-AD achieves state-of-the-art success rates under both non-reactive and reactive modes, with drastically reduced inference latency compared to existing knowledge-driven AD frameworks.

highlights.contribution: 提出轻量、不确定性感知、可终身学习的自驾 LLM 框架 LUNA-AD，平衡推理多样性、效率和持续改进。
highlights.innovation: 三系统设计：分析-蒸馏-反思；多智能体在线生成多样化决策示范，dual-head 把决策分布和文字解释统一蒸馏，闭环 reflection 用于增量改进。
highlights.method: 多智能体系统跑多假设推理生成带不确定性的决策示范；蒸馏到 dual-head 轻量模型一头出决策一头出文字；反思机制基于闭环反馈细化候选决策。
highlights.results: nuPlan 非反应和反应模式都拿 SOTA 成功率；推理延迟相比知识驱动 AD 大幅下降（具体数字未列）。

papers.title: VESTA: A Fully Automated Scenario Generation and Safety Evaluation Framework for LLM Agents
papers.summary: 现有 agent 安全评测多靠手写场景和静态 prompt，看不到执行过程中的真实风险。VESTA 把五大类风险实例化成 1072 个可量化执行场景，自动跑了 12 个 LLM agent 在两种权限设置下的过程级行为安全。结论：平均 ASR 47.1%，多个模型超 70%，agent 在执行过程中的安全问题远比想象严重。
papers.original_abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly evolving from simple text-based interaction systems into LLM agents that can maintain memory, use tools, access external environments, and execute tasks. As their capabilities and autonomy expand, the safety risks they face also become more diverse. Existing evaluations often rely on manually written scenarios, static prompts, or final-output judgments, making it difficult to capture the diverse risks that agents may face during task execution. We introduce VESTA, a fully automated scenario generation and safety evaluation framework for LLM agents. Based on five risk dimensions, VESTA instantiaes abstract and diverse safety risks in real-world task execution into 1,072 measurable evaluation scenarios. Using the automated evaluation pipeline, 12 LLM agents are evaluated under two authority contexts. The results show that current agents still face substantial behavioral safety risks during task execution, with an average ASR of 47.1% and several models exceeding 70%. These findings demonstrate the importance of executable, process-level evaluation for understanding and improving LLM agent safety.

highlights.contribution: 提出全自动 agent 安全场景生成与评估框架 VESTA，量化执行过程中的过程级安全风险。
highlights.innovation: 把五维抽象风险实例化为 1072 个可执行评测场景，再自动跑过程级评估，不再依赖静态 prompt 和最终输出判断。
highlights.method: 按五大风险维度合成场景；自动评估管线跑 12 个 LLM agent 在两种权限上下文下完整任务执行；用 ASR 这种过程级指标统计。
highlights.results: 平均 ASR 47.1%，多个模型超 70%，揭示执行期安全风险普遍。

papers.title: Agentic Search for Counterfactual Recourse under Fixed LLM Budgets
papers.summary: 反事实解释需要给用户多个备选方案，但靠 LLM prompt 会有算力上限。作者把问题定义成「固定 LLM 调用预算下找最多 oracle 合格反事实」的搜索问题，提出 Comp-MCTS：用 MCTS 框架，LLM 出方案、oracle 验证、用压缩引导剪枝。四个真实表格数据集上明显赢 LATS 类 baseline，质量-数量-代价权衡更好。
papers.original_abstract: Counterfactual recourse aims to provide actionable feature changes that would alter an unfavorable decision made by a predictive model. In practice, affected individuals often benefit from multiple feasible alternatives rather than a single optimal explanation. A natural way to produce such alternatives is to prompt large language models (LLMs). However, prompting incurs a practical constraint: the number of LLM calls is often the dominant computational and economic cost. Together, the need for multiple alternatives and this cost constraint shift the problem from finding a single high-quality counterfactual to efficiently generating a set of oracle-validated counterfactuals under a fixed LLM-call budget. In this work, we study counterfactual recourse generation in the LLM-agentic setting as a fixed-budget search problem and propose Comp-MCTS, an agentic tree-search framework that maximizes the yield of unique, oracle-validated counterfactuals under this budget while maintaining favorable quantity--quality trade-offs. Comp-MCTS allocates the budget toward novel intervention directions via LLM-based proposal generation, oracle validation, and compression-guided pruning, in a training-free, oracle-only setting. Experiments on four real-world tabular datasets show that Comp-MCTS substantially outperforms single-candidate LATS-style baselines in the yield of unique, oracle-validated counterfactuals, and offers favorable quantity--quality--efficiency trade-offs against stronger multi-candidate variants: comparable or higher yield at similar or lower oracle-evaluation cost on three of four datasets, plus competitive proximity, sparsity, and novelty.

highlights.contribution: 把反事实推荐重新定义为固定 LLM 调用预算下的搜索问题，并提出 agentic 树搜索 Comp-MCTS。
highlights.innovation: 训练 free，仅靠 oracle 与压缩引导剪枝；显式优化「单位 LLM 调用获得的唯一合规反事实数」，而不是单点最优解释。
highlights.method: MCTS 框架里 LLM 提议新干预方向，oracle 验证可行性，压缩信号引导剪枝避免重复探索；无需训练。
highlights.results: 四个真实表格数据集，比单候选 LATS 强；3/4 数据集上同等 oracle 成本下获得相当或更多 unique 合规反事实，且 proximity/sparsity/novelty 有竞争力。

papers.title: ConMem: Structured Memory-Guided Adaptation in Training-Free Multi-Agent Systems
papers.summary: 现有多智能体 memory/skill 方法常被噪声轨迹和稀薄关系建模拖累，还得训练。ConMem 把历史轨迹蒸成结构化 memory card 组成关系图，运行时按需检索并通过 card 图协调，免训练免高质监督。在多 benchmark、多主流 MAS 架构上稳定提升，剪枝 50%+ 候选、规划 overhead 减少 80%+。
papers.original_abstract: Recent advances have improved the adaptive capabilities of LLM-based multi-agent systems (MAS) through memory-, skill-, and learning-based approaches, yet these approaches remain challenged by noisy trajectories, insufficient modeling of memory-skill relations, and reliance on additional training or high-quality supervision. To address these limitations, we propose ConMem, a relation-aware and training-free framework that enables efficient multi-agent adaptation through cross-experience coordination. Specifically, ConMem distills historical interaction trajectories into structured memory cards to capture reusable strategies and cues, organizing them into a relation-aware memory graph. At runtime, ConMem retrieves cards according to task needs and coordinates them through the card graph to resolve strategy conflicts and recover their dependencies. Combined, these modules yield structured and relation-aware guidance, enabling robust, lightweight adaptation in multi-agent systems without additional training. Extensive experiments across multiple benchmarks and mainstream MAS architectures show consistent gains over existing memory architectures, with improved inference-time efficiency through pruning more than 50% of expanded candidates and reducing planning overhead by over 80%. Our codes are available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/ConMemCode

highlights.contribution: 提出训练-free、关系感知的多智能体 memory 框架 ConMem，用结构化 memory card 和关系图协调跨经验。
highlights.innovation: 把 memory 抽象为带关系的 card 图（不只是检索条目），运行时通过 card 图解决策略冲突和依赖恢复。
highlights.method: 把历史轨迹蒸成 memory card 抓可复用策略；按关系组织成 graph；推理时按任务检索 card，再通过 graph 协调消歧；无需训练。
highlights.results: 多 benchmark 多 MAS 架构上一致超过现有 memory；剪枝候选 50%+，规划 overhead 减少 80%+。

papers.title: RAILS: Verification-Native Clearing For Agentic Commerce
papers.summary: Agent 经济里支付、授权、LLM-as-judge 都不算「清算」。RAILS 提出 agentic 商务的清算原语，定义 7 个核心对象和形式化「可采信度分级验证」模型，保证任何对实际结算有影响的判定都不会基于低于义务门槛的证据。是个协议规范向论文，不是 ML 工作。
papers.original_abstract: Autonomous agents negotiate, purchase, deploy code, and move funds, but no neutral mechanism determines whether they   met their delegated obligation, who is responsible when they did not, or which settlement action follows. This is the   agentic clearing problem. Tool protocols (MCP), inter-agent communication (A2A), payment rails (x402), mandate and   network agent protocols (AP2, Visa, Mastercard), and settlement-risk standards each assume that determination and none   produce it.   Clearing is the missing primitive. Payment is not clearing. Authorization is not clearing. LLM-as-judge evaluation is   not clearing. Settlement-risk escrow is not clearing: it consumes clearing decisions.   RAILS (Real-Time Agent Integrity & Ledger Settlement) is the integrity and clearing layer for agentic commerce,   spanning a per-output reliability score, a published reliability record, and a clearing function that consumes them.   The clearing protocol at its core closes that gap. Seven primitives (Obligation Object, Evidence Envelope,   Verification Mesh, Clearing Decision, Settlement Instruction, Clearing Passport, Finality Rules), bound by a formal   model of admissibility-graded verification, together yield a soundness property: no financially material settlement is   supported by evidence below the obligation's admissibility floor. The property is falsifiable against the spec. We   are not aware of a prior agent-commerce verification mechanism that states a property of this kind. The approaches   nearest to it emit a pass, a delivery guarantee, a bare score, or an equilibrium.   This paper specifies that clearing protocol.

highlights.contribution: 提出 agentic 商务的清算协议 RAILS，把「智能体是否履约」变成可验证可裁定的原语。
highlights.innovation: 首次给出 agent-commerce 验证机制的形式化可证伪属性（可采信度门槛下的 soundness），区别于 pass / 投递保证 / 评分。
highlights.method: 定义 7 个原语：Obligation Object、Evidence Envelope、Verification Mesh、Clearing Decision、Settlement Instruction、Clearing Passport、Finality Rules；用 admissibility-graded verification 形式化模型证明 soundness。
highlights.results: 无实验，只给出可证伪的协议规范和 soundness 性质。

papers.title: From Holistic Evaluation to Structured Criteria: Rubrics Across the Evolving LLM Landscape
papers.summary: 本文是一篇综述：把「rubric」当作贯穿 LLM 评测、强化学习训练、安全对齐的统一框架。作者梳理 rubric 在评价层（分解整体判断）、训练层（dense 反馈）、内生层（模型自生成 rubric 驱动自改进）三层作用，并讨论可靠性和威胁模型。
papers.original_abstract: As Large Language Models (LLMs) advance toward open-ended autonomous agents, the mechanisms used to evaluate and guide their behavior must evolve accordingly. This work introduces the rubric as a unifying framework capturing this evolution, characterizing rubrics as a dynamic response to successive LLM paradigm shifts that recurs across otherwise independent efforts in evaluation, reinforcement learning, and safety alignment. We define rubrics as explicit criteria sets that transform complex quality judgments into structured and actionable standards, and demonstrate that their recurrence across these research threads is not coincidental. We systematically organize existing rubric designs, examine their construction and optimization, and analyze their role across evaluation and training. Rubrics manifest at three progressively deeper levels: at the evaluative level, they decompose holistic judgments into verifiable dimensions; at the training level, they serve as dense feedback signals providing process-level guidance where scalar rewards fall short; at the intrinsic level, they emerge dynamically from model behaviors, driving self-improvement. We further assess rubric reliability across generation quality, execution fidelity, theoretical constraints, and security threats, before surveying rubric-based benchmarks across diverse domains. By rendering assessment transparent and decomposable, rubrics translate human value expectations into machine-learnable signals, serving as the enduring bridge between human intentions and machine behavior.

highlights.contribution: 把 rubric 抽象为 LLM 评测/训练/对齐三大领域的统一框架，并系统综述其使用方式。
highlights.innovation: 首次把跨方向看似独立的 rubric 用法归一到一个框架，并区分评价 / 训练 / 内生三层级。
highlights.method: 综述：系统整理 rubric 构造与优化方法，分析其在不同任务的角色，并从生成质量、执行保真度、理论约束、安全威胁四个维度评估可靠性。
highlights.results: 无新实验，给出综合性 taxonomy 与 benchmark 整理。

papers.title: Structuring agentic AI for HPC code modernization
papers.summary: 把一份 6 万行 Fortran 单线程 MPI 求解器 NMAP-RKPM 现代化成 OpenMP 并行 C++ MPI。作者发现裸 LLM 不够用，于是建了一套高度结构化的「手把手」agentic 方法：手写示例引导、保持持续可构建、限定会话作用域，几个月就完成迁移。是经验报告。
papers.original_abstract: Modernization of legacy scientific codes is often necessary to keep up with the ever-evolving changes in the compute resource ecosystem. Parallelization and migration from poorly supported software ecosystems are two of the most time-consuming activities in the research software engineering field. This paper presents our experience in the successful, two-phase AI-assisted modernization of NMAP-RKPM, a roughly 60,000-line, 3D explicit solid mechanics physics engine based on the Reproducing Kernel Particle Method (RKPM). We converted this single-threaded, Fortran based MPI application into a OpenMP-parallel C++ based MPI tool in the span of a few months. While Large Language Model (LLM) based tools on their own proved inadequate, we developed a highly structured "hand-holding" agentic AI methodology, like providing manually created examples, ensuring continuous buildability and limiting session scope, that was instead highly effective. The paper provides both the AI-assisted steps that were successful and the problems that we had to overcome, alongside the reasoning behind the chosen path.

highlights.contribution: 给出一个把工业级 6 万行 Fortran 物理求解器迁移到 C++ OpenMP 的可复用 agentic AI 方法论。
highlights.innovation: 提出「hand-holding」结构化 agentic 方法（手写示例、连续可构建约束、会话作用域限制），缓解纯 LLM 在大型科学代码上的失败模式。
highlights.method: 两阶段迁移：先 Fortran→C++ 再并行化；每步限定 LLM 会话作用域、用手写示例对齐风格、保证编译可构建、人工把关问题样例。
highlights.results: 成功把 NMAP-RKPM (≈6 万行) 在几个月内迁成 OpenMP C++ MPI 版，且持续可构建可运行（无定量加速数字）。

papers.title: Quantitative Promise Theory: Intentionality and Inference in Autonomous Agents
papers.summary: 本文是一篇综述性观点文，讨论如何用贝叶斯概率和信息论优化（含 active inference）配合 Promise Theory 描述自主智能体，包括边界条件、对齐意图、群体超智能体行为等。没有实验，偏理论 / 工程框架反思。
papers.original_abstract: I discuss some quantitative representations of Promise Theory for processes involving autonomous agents. Agent models are common in software systems, machine learning, and biology, for example, but may also apply to physics and other forms of engineering. I describe how Bayesian probability and information theoretic optimization, including Active Inference, may be incorporated with promise semantics -- as well as how Promise Theory supplements solutions, helping to avoid probability's pitfalls, which include non-local coordination, calibrating, and normalizing probabilistic computations. The role of boundary conditions in constraining allowed states and selecting decision thresholds is a form of promise, and agent alignment provides a scalable definition of intent. Autonomous agents may congeal into swarms with superagent characteristics by trying to minimize their information, despite uncertainty that works to maximize it. The use of Promise Theory involves some research challenges as well as stylistic preferences.

highlights.contribution: 把 Promise Theory 与贝叶斯概率、Active Inference 结合，给自主智能体的意图建模和对齐提出语义级补充。
highlights.innovation: 用 promise semantics 解决概率框架在非局部协调、标定、归一化上的痛点；把 agent alignment 当作可扩展的意图定义。
highlights.method: 理论分析：描述 promise 与 Bayesian/info-theoretic 优化的耦合方式；讨论边界条件如何充当 promise 来约束允许状态和决策阈值。
highlights.results: 无实验。
